findings.rationale: Markdown materialization uses only the predictable process ID and source stem, then calls fs::write without create_new. An existing file or symlink at that path is silently truncated, and concurrent materializations in one process share and delete the same path. Use a securely created unique temporary file with exclusive creation.

The document-check path accepts a signed approval and exposes its approver, requirements, and key ID without loading trust keys or verifying the signature. A forged signed record can therefore be incorporated into a matching artifact that document check reports as conformant, unlike document generation, which explicitly fails closed on invalid or untrusted signatures.

Generation renders AppliedApproval.artifact_digest from target.reviewed_digest, while document check reconstructs the same overlay from target.digest. These fields intentionally identify different artifacts, so a valid generated document can be reconstructed differently and falsely reported as drifted whenever the reviewed artifact digest differs from the canonical target digest.

approval_evaluation can return non-valid states, but approval check exits nonzero only for the single literal signature-invalid state. The overlay also adds requirements from every evaluation without requiring a valid status. Consequently stale or otherwise failed approvals can produce a successful check and can be propagated into ledger approval data.

After an effect completion is rejected by the model, replay still records the key as completed, removes it from pending, and records the outcome as observed. This mutates lifecycle bookkeeping for a transition that never occurred, hides the outstanding request, and can make a later valid retry appear to be a duplicate irreversible commit.
